events.text: The Wasa Star started traffic on the route connecting Vaasa to Sundsvall.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 July 1981 the brand new Wasa Star started traffic on the route connecting Vaasa in Finland to Sundsvall in Sweden

events.text: The ship was moved to the Vaasa – Umeå route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In February 1982 the ship was moved to the Vaasa – Umeå route

events.text: The ship was grounded near Holmsund.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 14 February 1981 the ship was grounded near Holmsund

events.text: The Wasa Star continued from Helsinki to Kiel, Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 16 February 1981 the Wasa Star continued from Helsinki to Kiel , Germany

events.text: The Wasa Star returned to the Vaasa – Sundsvall route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 April 1982 the Wasa Star returned to the Vaasa – Sundsvall route

events.text: She was taken out of traffic and laid up in Sundsvall.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 31 August 1982 she was taken out of traffic and laid up in Sundsvall

events.text: Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line, Greece.
events.subject: self
events.quote: until May 1983 , when Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line , Greece

events.text: She started trafficking on a route connecting Patras, Greece to Ancona, Italy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June she started trafficking on a route connecting Patras , Greece to Ancona , Italy

events.text: The Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line on 29 August 1983

events.text: She was renamed MS Peter Wessel and started operating on the Larvik–Frederikshavn route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March of the same year she was renamed MS Peter Wessel

events.text: The Peter Wessel collided with MS Sydfjord.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Peter Wessel collided with MS Sydfjord on 27 June 1986

events.text: Peter Wessel was extended at Blohm + Voss, Hamburg, Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Peter Wessel was extended by meters at Blohm + Voss , Hamburg , Germany in 1988

events.text: Color Line chartered the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In October 1996 Color Line chartered the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line

events.text: Parts of the cardeck were built in with cabins.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1999 parts of the cardeck were built in with cabins

events.text: The ship was rebuilt again at Remontowa, Poland.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In spring 2003 the ship was rebuilt again , this time at Remontowa , Poland

events.text: Color Line bought the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2004 Color Line bought the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line
